about_pullquote: I started Gloss Finish because sloppy prep and cheap finishes frustrated me. We do it right.
about_para_1: Gloss Finish UK was founded in 2009 with a simple idea: painting and decorating shouldn't be a headache. Too many trades cut corners on prep work or use poor-quality materials. We saw a gap in the market for honest, thorough decorators who actually care about the finish. Over fifteen years, we've built a reputation across Nottingham for reliability, attention to detail, and work that lasts.
about_para_2: Every job starts with a proper conversation about what you want and a realistic quote—no surprises when we invoice. We're meticulous about protecting your home, we clean up daily, and we always leave your space better than we found it. Many of our customers call us back years later for new rooms or refresh work. That loyalty means everything to us.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our lounge redecorated and it looks amazing. The team was tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. Colour advice was spot on too. Definitely using them again for the hallway.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Exterior paintwork on our Victorian terrace was brilliant. They took proper time with the prep—scraped and filled everything. Paint's held up through a proper winter and still looks fresh. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Called Gloss Finish for a quick quote after another painter let us down. Not only did they come out promptly, they spotted damp patches I'd missed and advised me before starting work. Honest and thorough. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David P.
